154: Roti Canai is a type of Asian flatbread originating from Malaysia and Singapore, made from a mixture of flour, ghee, and water, typically cooked to a crispy golden brown on a hot griddle. It is usually served immediately and enjoyed by dipping it into a rich and flavorful curry or dhal.
1: Chicken Fried Rice is a popular Asian dish made from cooked rice stir-fried with diced chicken, vegetables, and seasonings, often served as a flavorful and filling main course. It's typically eaten hot, garnished with green onions and served with other dishes or as a standalone meal.
65: Coconut Shrimp is a popular Caribbean dish where large shrimp are coated in a mixture of shredded coconut, breadcrumbs, and spices, then deep-fried until crispy and golden brown. It is typically served hot with a side of sweet chili sauce for dipping, allowing you to enjoy the crunchy exterior and tender shrimp with a sweet and spicy kick.
